name: Unrestricted Trees
description: Allows Minecraft trees to grow in confined spaces, even near redstone machinery and other solid blocks. Preserves existing structures by safely skipping obstructed tree placements. Supports giant trees, standard trees, branching trees and compatibility with Vanilla Tweaks Timber. Developed and tested for Minecraft Java 1.21.11.
